engine.notes: The Backline downtown has been the training center and stage since 2011; Big Canvas runs the family-friendly Blackstone Theater, and Ware House in Little Bohemia is the new room with the weekly jam. Omaha Funny Bone is a stand-up club. Big Canvas's older .com domain now redirects to bigcanvascomedy.org.

entries.name: The Backline Comedy Theatre
entries.summary: Omaha's multi-genre comedy institution, founded in 2011 by Dylan Oakes Rohde, with improv, stand-up and sketch four nights a week downtown, a training center and free long-form jams.
entries.schedule: Shows four nights a week; The ARENA improv competition Fridays; Jam Town free on Thursdays 6:30pm
signals: Founded 2011; began as improv classes in a gallery basement
The ARENA, Omaha's improv competition, in its 13th year
Jam Town free long-form jam, no experience required
Classes in improv and sketch writing with scholarships
Co-founded Omaha Comedy Fest
Full bar; 18+ or with a guardian
entries.reasons: Fifteen years, its own downtown theater, shows four nights a week, a weekly free jam and a training center; class levels and dates live only on its ticketing site.

entries.name: Big Canvas Comedy (Blackstone Theater)
entries.summary: Omaha's nonprofit family-friendly short-form improv group, which runs the intimate Blackstone Theater on Farnam Street with improv shows on Fridays and comedy classes taught by its faculty.
entries.schedule: Fridays: Guardians of the Giggle (1st), The Laugh Crafters (2nd), Making a Scene (3rd)
signals: Non-profit short-form improv group
Operates the Blackstone Theater, established 2019
Three Friday improv shows a month plus stand-up and musical improv
Comedy classes with Big Canvas faculty
Upcoming shows listed Oct 2-17, 2026
entries.reasons: A nonprofit with its own small theater, weekly family-friendly shows and classes, but the class details and founding year are not on the site.

entries.name: Ware House Comedy Theater
entries.summary: Omaha's newest comedy room in Little Bohemia, with a free long-form improv jam every Wednesday, monthly improv showcases from house and touring teams, and eight-week improv classes capped at 14.
entries.schedule: Improv jam Wednesdays 9pm (free); open mic Sundays 7:30pm; shows 7:30pm and 9pm
signals: Free Wednesday improv jam, sign-up 8:30pm
Level One Improv: eight weeks, Sundays, Nov 15 - Jan 3, $200
Fast Play and Monoscene five-week classes
Monthly improv showcases incl. Bully Mullet, The Strangers, Dad Jokes
Free shows Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday
Shows dated through Nov 28, 2026
entries.reasons: Dated classes, a weekly jam and a packed improv calendar in its own room, but it is the newest venue in town with little standing yet.

entries.name: The Weisenheimers
entries.area: Benson Theatre and Omaha Community Playhouse
entries.summary: An award-winning short-form improv group performing around the heartland for nearly three decades, with a few ticketed Omaha shows a year at the Benson Theatre and the Playhouse's Howard Drew Theatre.
entries.schedule: Next show Nov 13, 2026 at Benson Theatre; played Howard Drew Theatre Apr 25, 2026
signals: Nearly three decades of performing
Six Omaha Entertainment and Arts Awards for Best Comedy Ensemble
Short-form, game-style shows
Podcast 'It Could Be Worse'
Shows posted for Nov 13, 2026
entries.reasons: Long-lived and decorated, but a touring troupe with no venue, no classes and only occasional public dates.

entries.name: Jewish Community Center of Omaha
entries.summary: The JCC's performing arts academy offers Sketch Comedy & Improv for Adults, an eight-week Wednesday evening class open to members and non-members.
signals: Adults 18+
Eight Wednesday sessions
Open to non-members
Part of a wider theater academy
entries.reasons: A real, dated, public-enrolment adult improv class at an established community center, but a single course with no shows.
